objective.target_user: People who capture frequent voice notes
objective.trigger: The user has a thought while unable to type
objective.core_job: Turn spoken thoughts into organized actions
objective.current_alternative: Transcription plus notes plus task manager
objective.product_promise: Convert one recording into confirmed next actions
objective.minimum_success: A user records, reviews, and saves one accurate action list

references.name: Example Reference A
references.do_not_copy: Name, icon, copy, or visual assets

change_directions.title: One-step voice-to-action confirmation
change_directions.current_failure: Users move between three tools and lose actions
change_directions.change: Generate a structured summary and actions, then require confirmation
change_directions.expected_outcome: Less tool switching and fewer lost actions
change_directions.validation_metric: Median time from recording to confirmed action

brand.positioning: Voice capture that ends in clear action
brand.icon_direction: An original abstract waveform resolving into one check mark

ui.direction: Quiet utility with one primary action per screen
ui.typography: System sans serif with 17px body and strong numeric hierarchy

stack: to be selected by the workbench
build.master_prompt: Read every package file, freeze the stated scope and acceptance criteria, then build and validate the smallest working prototype without adding unapproved features.

user: A target user can complete the record-to-confirmed-action flow
The low-confidence state is understandable and recoverable
The flow is accessible with large text and screen reader
project_manager: Only the approved core direction is implemented
Normal, failure, offline, restart, and permission paths are tested
Source, tests, screenshots, and known risks are delivered
growth: The one-sentence positioning matches the actual product
Install, activation, value, and return events are measurable
Store assets use original brand and visual language

growth.positioning: From spoken thought to confirmed action in one flow
creative_angles: one flow instead of three tools
growth.cold_start_test: Run a small landing-page intent test before paid build expansion

stop_conditions: Target users do not complete the confirmation flow
The result is not better than the current multi-tool workflow
